Research project requirements at ICMR-NIHR

The recruitment notification lists technical, research and administrative project posts associated with health research.

Requirement

Published opportunities for research, technical and administrative roles across health research projects.

Workforce approach

The published recruitment notice provides the role context and relevant application information. It does not establish the full delivery scope or project governance arrangements.

Evidence available

Organization, role context and published eligibility information. Availability must be confirmed against the vacancy notice.

Scale, governance & outcomes

Verified deployment totals, performance results and contract-specific governance information have not been provided. No outcome or client testimonial is inferred from the listing.
